data_roles.research: 2018-2025 previously inspected; allowed for training and selection
data_roles.independent: 2026 not used to select parameters; retrospective provider vintages are not certified historical PIT
data_roles.prospective: actual immutable predictions created after freeze and before next exchange open only
data_roles.financial_and_industry_vintages: retain first-observed UTC and revisions; do not backdate current membership or updated financials
data_roles.originals: phase1 dataset, models, factor code and outcomes remain immutable

candidate_groups.membership: dated and visible at signal; no current-membership historical backfill

candidate_groups.normalization: market-wide state is not demeaned to zero within each cross-section
candidate_groups.timing: entry only when prior decision CSI300 close exceeds trailing200-session average; exit at next open after state switches off

candidate_groups.definition: operational ONeil-style consolidation proxy, not a canonical named formula
candidate_groups.bounds: previous20/60-session maximum and minimum causal closes excluding signal; width high/low-1
candidate_groups.timing: enter if close exceeds previous20 high, width<=0.25, volume>=1.5*previous50 mean; exit below previous20 low, next tradable open; unknown inputs do not open a position
market_state and oneil_box entry conditions; either exit condition

validation.selection: research-only mature labels, purged before each fold; paired net excess vs identically retrained baseline; tie -> fewer trees
controls: matched retrained baseline with original factors and same training cutoff
eligible equal-weight raw-share reference with dividends and same costs
validation.claims: four groups x three horizons x ranking/timing =24 prespecified comparisons; Bonferroni familywise alpha0.05/24
validation.uncertainty: paired calendar-block bootstrap,63 sessions,2000 repetitions,seed42; insufficient independent history yields insufficient evidence
validation.selection_and_attribution: report sector/market/exposure/cost contributions separately; no causal single-stock explanation from global feature importance

execution.daily_predictions: all horizons every observed session; next exchange session open execution only
execution.baseline_rebalances: 5/20-session grid anchored first2026 session;12 calendar months, no hold-period shortening
execution.held_valuation: raw shares,cash,receivables; unresolved positive holdings stop, never delete or zero
execution.scopes: historical ST/*ST and Beijing excluded from new candidates; existing blocked positions remain in account

acceptance.long_horizon: 12-month independent outcomes remain pending until actually mature; no short-horizon proxy presented as12m evidence
